text:
Nina - Marketing: quick thread — finalize hero lines + one CTA for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. need copy + form wiring by Fri. :calendar:
Diego - Growth: single CTA for webinar signups = 'See it running'. route leads by company_tier & infra_needs.
Priya - Product: Dedicated hero should emphasize SLOs and predictability. suggestion: 'Dedicated capacity — enforced latency SLOs.'
Omar - Design: Private page visual: no cloud shots. use 'locked rack' or network map. keep hero simple.
Lena - Content: concise hero drafts (<=45 chars): Hosted: 'Hosted API — launch in minutes.' Dedicated: 'Dedicated GPUs — steady production.' Private: 'Private deploys — inside your network.' subline: 'Batching, caching and routing to cut latency & cost.'
Nina - Marketing: CTA pairing: primary='See it running' on all pages; secondary='Start trial' on Hosted/Dedicated; Private shows 'Contact sales'.
Diego - Growth: Zapier -> SFDC mapping (draft):
```
source: website
page: {{page_slug}}
company_tier: {{company_tier}}
infra_needs: {{infra_needs}}
est_annual_spend: {{estimated_annual_spend}}
model_size: {{model_size}}
```
Routing rules: if company_tier == Enterprise OR infra_needs contains 'VPC' OR est_annual_spend >= 50000 -> owner = AE; else -> SDR-nurture.
Priya - Product: add optional 'expected_qps' to form so infra can preselect batching configs.
Omar - Design: hero chip per page: Hosted: 'p95 token latency ~80ms', Dedicated: 'sustained throughput 200 tok/s per GPU', Private: 'SLOs & custom networking'.
Lena - Content: small test plan: A/B 'See it running' vs 'Watch demo' on Hosted for 1 week, measure conversion and AE pickup.
FormBot: Form created: https://forms.example.com/redwood-apr-launch. Fields: company_name, company_tier, infra_needs, est_annual_spend, model_size, expected_qps. Reminder set for Wed 17:00 'Copy freeze for tri pages'.
Nina - Marketing: timeline check — copy freeze Wed EOD, designs Thu, dev deploy Fri. please post final snippets here and I'll assemble CMS import. :rocket:
